candidate.name: LGTS-f4-Full
claimed_properties: strictly increasing for finite x when alpha,beta>0
ReLU limit as alpha tends to zero

nested_ablations.purpose: known Squareplus-type algebraic base with fixed alpha
isolates the logistic correction against the fixed base
tests the joint contribution of learnable alpha and beta

developmental_screen.rationale: This is the only locally completed dataset and ResNet18 was the prior near-best LGTS setting. The screen is exploratory and cannot establish cross-dataset superiority.

promotion_rule.minimum: LGTS-f4-Full must improve over LGTS-f4-Fixed and LGTS-f4-Base-Squareplus on validation macro-F1
promotion_rule.parsimony: If Full does not materially exceed Alpha or Beta, retain the simpler learned variant
promotion_rule.confirmation: Freeze the selected formula before additional seeds, models, datasets, or official-test evaluation

novelty_policy: The algebraic base is explicitly treated as Squareplus-type prior art. No exact-form novelty claim is permitted without a documented systematic literature and formula search.
